name: Mapd
tagline: Drop a pin on a new development and get permits, zoning, transit and service data summarised as likely local impacts.

awards: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Enactus Challenge

problem: Residents see new construction but the facts are scattered across open-data portals.
solution: Aggregates permits, zoning, transit and 311 records for a place and time window, links them, and summarises likely traffic, noise and amenity impacts on a minimal map.
demo_moment: Team-described: paste a permit address and read the plain-language impact summary.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Finalists” and “United Nations Sustainable Development Goals Enactus Challenge” and “Best Design” among 217 submissions.
Shipped a deployed product within 24 hours, by design.
A finalist that also won the design and SDG prizes.

lessons: Open data becomes compelling when one pin answers a resident's question.
